title: AI SDLC Pre-Gate Adversarial Review
description: A fresh-context adversarial review of a specification or a plan, recorded before the human gate that would approve it.

schema_version.description: Record schema generation. Absent means 0: a record written before schema versioning existed.

reviewer_model.description: Model that produced the review. Independence is enforced on the model family, not the agent label.

author_model.description: Model that authored the artifact under review, when it is known.

artifact_hash.description: Hash of the artifact reviewed, so a later edit is visible as a review that no longer covers what it claims to.
